summary: Almaden Minerals Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results, reflecting typical operational expenses and no material unusual items. There is no mention of any transaction, strategic review, capital return, or other special situation event. The Form 6-K serves as the US equivalent of a quarterly report under the Exchange Act. No deal terms apply.
